payload.title: Reader handle and profile (reader-steering)
payload.description:
As a signed-in reader, I want to pick a unique public handle once so that my votes are attributed to a name, not an identity.

Feature: Reader handle
  Scenario: First handle
    Given a signed-in reader with no handle
    When they set the handle 'quiet-fox'
    Then /api/reader/me returns the handle and a random readerId
  Scenario: Taken handle
    Given another reader holds 'Quiet-Fox'
    When this reader sets 'quiet-fox'
    Then the answer is 409
  Scenario: Reserved handle
    When a reader sets 'admin'
    Then the answer is 422
